note: A synthetic client (Slice 127 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: We rely on 40 critical suppliers, and 12 of them have no tested exit plan.

answers.common.decision: Which supplier risks to fix first; the chief risk officer decides.
answers.common.materials: 4 of those 12 suppliers support our payments. A payments outage costs us about $75,000 an hour.
answers.consulting.current-state: Supplier exit plans are written but most have never been tested.
answers.consulting.success: Every critical supplier has a tested exit plan.
